description:
Extract layer 2 topologies from SNMP enabled switches.
Requires collector version 30.000 or greater.
name: Networking_L2_snmpSwitch
technology:
Configurable custom properties:

"topo.mapTrunks" - map trunk interfaces, defaults to false
"topo.mapPortChannels" - map port channel interfaces, defaults to false
"topo.mapInterfaceBridges"- array of interface names to map: [eth0, eth1]
"topo.timeout" - generic SNMP timeout, defaults to 30000 ms
"topo.interfacesTimeout" - interface SNMP walk timeout,  defaults to 10000 ms
"topo.dot1dTimeout" - dot1d SNMP walk timeout, defaults to 2000 ms
"topo.dot1dInterfaceIndexMapTimeout" - dot1d interface to index map SNMP walk timeout, defaults to 2000 ms
"topo.bridgeMacsThreshold" - max number of interface bridge MACs to map
"topo.multipleBridgeMacsThreshold" - max number of duplicate interface bridge MACs to map
"topo.blockedmultipliers" - Multipliers to block when matching unindexed bridge entries to interfaces.
Requires collector version of 35.003 or greater.
